name: 30326 · Atlanta, GA
findings: ZIP 30326 (Atlanta) has 170 nonprofit organizations. 70 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 54 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (12% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30326 (Atlanta) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 30326 (Atlanta) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 33 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
